# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

Band Office is committed to a welcoming, respectful, and harassment-free community for educators, students, contributors, self-hosters, and school technology staff regardless of background, identity, experience, or role.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate, patient, and specific.
- Critique ideas and changes, not people.
- Respect the operational knowledge of educators and the technical knowledge of contributors.
- Assume good intent while remaining accountable for impact.
- Protect private school and student information.
- Accept maintainer decisions about safety, scope, and release readiness.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, intimidation, threats, or discriminatory language
- Sexualized language or unwanted attention
- Personal attacks, trolling, or sustained disruption
- Publishing someone else’s private information
- Sharing real student, guardian, staff, payment, or school records
- Deliberately bypassing security or responsible-disclosure boundaries

## Scope

This policy applies in project repositories, issues, pull requests, discussions, community events, and public spaces where someone is representing Band Office.

## Reporting and enforcement

Do not place sensitive conduct reports in a public issue.

Contact the project owner through a private method listed on their GitHub profile. If that is unavailable or inappropriate, use GitHub’s report-content or abuse-reporting tools. Include links, dates, and relevant context, but do not redistribute private school or student information.

Maintainers may edit or remove content, lock threads, reject contributions, issue a warning, temporarily restrict participation, or permanently ban a participant. Reports will be handled as privately and promptly as practical.

## Attribution

This policy is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html).
